positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
● Worked autonomously on additional features for the Checkout pages of a web commerce grocery application on both a legacy Vue/JSP app and newer Node/React app that are both used to render pages via server side rendering
● Maintained and authored new types, queries, and mutations in a shared GraphQL project to ensure aligned data requests and responses across multiple client platforms
● Contributed to a shared theme and component library creating reusable base components in Typescript/React that were then consumed by multiple product teams
● Interfaced daily with teammates on Web, iOS, Android, Design, and Product to align a unified approach to product features and development processes
● Mentored an intern through a consumer facing project with many unknowns helping them navigate the end to end process of development from product, to design, to system architecture, and client integration. Mentored an additional intern helping them learn about the SDLC and how to handle real world enterprise development
● Hosted tech talks about explorations into new patterns of development in the web space giving thorough presentations as well as real world application demonstrations.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
● Contributed to multiple features for an internal web portal built on React and Hapi for cloud experiences such as a platform for cloud-agnostic FaaS and PaaS, cloud system health, cost reporting for provisioned services, and real-time application management and insight
● Developed and managed ETL tasks to keep Elasticsearch indexes hydrated and in sync with upstream source of truth with atomic index rollover patterns to ensure no downtime
● Led the initial architectural design for a metadata search and discovery tool based off of Apache Atlas and leading towards LinkedIn Wherehows
● Collaborated on the initial design and implementation of a centralized web portal for aggregation of all internal data lineage and discovery built on React and Express and leveraging Kafka for event driven architecture to be used by all developers as the central point of data discovery
● Assigned as a mentor to an intern for a Summer to guide and assist with the project as well as provide advice for general career development

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern - Infrastucture
positions.description:
Designed and implemented a metrics collecting service for distributed, independent services across data centers to collect data on a per minute basis and aggregate the data across the data centers. 
Integrated an internal security service leveraging SSL certificates to provide subscriber access to sensitive data into existing legacy services. 
Designed and implemented an extensible task executor using configs and scripts for a re-architecture of an existing legacy service. 
Worked autonomously and independently on multiple projects to ensure delivery of services to production

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Worked as a technical contributor in the development of a new, cloud based, security product.
Participated in all phases of development from design to implementation, testing and operations.
Designed new features in both the front-end and the back-end that was pushed to production every week.
Dealt with all areas of the product including the database, REST API, Continuous Integration, and data modeling.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: Worked in a biological laboratory that studied mast cell activation in the mesenteric system. Performed staining procedures of mesenteric tissue to later analyze under a high-powered microscope. Also collaborated with other researchers to create a research poster for display.
